result:
Done.

ROOT CAUSE
`variants/bug02/movegen.inc:908`, in `makeMove`'s `mkHalf` block, compared the moving piece type against `WN` (knight, =2) instead of `WP` (pawn, =1), so the fifty-move clock reset on knight moves and incremented on pawn moves — a violation of contract clause C9 (`C9_halfmove`).

FILES TOUCHED
- `variants/bug02/movegen.inc` — the one-line fix (`cp WN` → `cp WP`); `chess.bin`/`chess.tap` rebuilt by `make`.
- `contract/bridge/emu.py` — the load-bearing bridge change: `TAP` repointed from the frozen `contract/artifacts/chess.tap` to `variants/bug02/chess.tap` (the build under test); paths made workspace-relative; added `run(..., tap=)` and `pos_tap(fen)`.
- `contract/bridge/b8_halfmove.py` — new gate layer (C9 vs the running engine from high-clock positions).
- `contract/bridge/b2_mutations.py` — witness `clockPos`, 3 probe observations, mutation B11 `fifty-resets-on-knight`.
- `contract/bridge/b7_findings.py` — hardcoded absolute path made workspace-relative.
- `contract/bridge/run_all.sh` — runs b8; counts 11→12 and 10→11.
- `contract/SUMMARY.md`, `contract/DECISIONS.md` (new D-TAP-1, D-C9-1).
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` at the workspace root.

The contract itself was deliberately NOT extended: C9 already stated the property exactly (spec:832, twin:789, kernel witness T24g_C9). What was missing was detection, not specification (D-C9-1).

GATE STATUS
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS. All four repros match Expected: a2a3@98 → 0/play; +e8e7 → 1/play; Na1-b3@40 → 41; 99+Rb2-b3 → 100/draw.
- `make` reproducibility — PASS, and the rebuilt tape is byte-identical to the pristine `contract/artifacts/chess.tap` (md5 783b72ba018897b1311a7af0295ab041), so the fix is provably the sole change.
- `variants/bug02` `make test` — PASS (golden board, 1.e4 reply, PERFT OK, tape save/load, 128K banked TT).
- `contract/bridge/run_all.sh` — GREEN, 12/12 layers, exit 0 (b0–b8 + s1–s3).
- Fault class pinned — PASS. b8 was proved RED on the buggy build first (17 runs, 155 checks, 10 failures, exit 1, failing exactly the halfmove/gameState checks), GREEN after. b2's B11 pins the same class in the twin; before `clockPos` the mutation provably survived the whole battery.
- Attack round — 1 round, synchronous, verdict no BLOCKING defect; gate closed. Six NON-BLOCKING findings recorded in FIX_NOTES §5.

KNOWINGLY LEFT OPEN
- The reviewer disproved a claim I had written: b5 also catches this bug once `emu.py` is repointed (red on 4 of its 5 games). I re-verified that independently and corrected the overclaim in b8's header, run_all.sh, SUMMARY.md, DECISIONS.md and FIX_NOTES. The frozen tape was the entire blind spot; b8 is deliberate redundancy plus the 99/100 draw boundary b5 never reaches.
- b8 does not pin promotion, castling, en passant, bishop or queen moves (F-C). All were hand-probed against the shipped build and are correct — a gap in the pin, not in the engine.
- `emu.py` uses deprecated `tempfile.mktemp` and leaks ~900 KB of temp files per b8 run (F-D); pre-existing pattern.
- `SUMMARY.md` says "10 findings" where `organic_findings.md` has 11 (F-E); pre-existing drift, not introduced here.
- `run_all.sh` does not run `make` before judging the tape, so a stale build could still be gated; `emu.py` is hardwired to the `bug02` variant.
